data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kirios' meaning 'lord' or 'sovereign'. In Christian contexts, the name Kiril is associated with St. Cyril of Alexandria, a prominent theologian and bishop in early Christianity. The name Kiril carries the meaning “Lordly, Sovereign” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kiril usually hope their child will grow to embody lordly, sovereign and live with faith, good character and purpose.

By bearing this name, individuals are called to follow in the footsteps of St. Cyril, living a life of faith, intellectual rigor, and dedication to the teachings of the Church.
